question: When the numbers 7807, 8022 and 8667 were divided by the greatest number x, then the remainder in each case was the same. The sum of the digits of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the differences between the given numbers: 8022 − 7807 = 215 and 8667 − 8022 = 645.

The greatest number x leaving the same remainder is the HCF of these differences.

x = HCF(215, 645) = 215.

Sum of the digits of x = 2 + 1 + 5 = 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 7807, 8022, and 8667.

**Formula Used:**

Greatest number dividing a, b, and c leaving the same remainder = HCF of |a − b|, |b − c|, and |c − a|.

**Calculations:**

⇒ First difference = |7807 − 8022| = 215

⇒ Second difference = |8022 − 8667| = 645

⇒ Third difference = |8667 − 7807| = 860

⇒ Now, find the HCF of 215, 645, and 860.

⇒ 215 = 215 × 1

⇒ 645 = 215 × 3

⇒ 860 = 215 × 4

⇒ HCF of (215, 645, 860) = 215

⇒ The greatest number x = 215

⇒ Sum of the digits of x = 2 + 1 + 5 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Rule for Same Remainder (Value Not Given)

Greatest number dividing a, b, c leaving same remainder = HCF of (|a − b|, |b − c|, |c − a|).

HCF Rule for Different Remainders

Greatest number dividing a, b, c leaving remainders p, q, r = HCF of (a − p, b − q, c − r).

HCF Rule for Same Given Remainder

Greatest number dividing a, b, c leaving same given remainder R = HCF of (a − R, b − R, c − R).
